title: Adam Cato and little Butch revisited
summary: Tuts repeats that Adam Cato went to Illinois, and that little Butch now teaches piano.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Adam? Adam. He's around Illinois somewhere. They tell me he never came back here no more. He stayed up there. He's good. He left here playing here. That was Jimmy Kato's cousin. Jimmy Kato was a very big fella. He played something on the other way behind him. Oh yeah. And little Butch, little Butch, they teach piano now. I meet him on the canal all the time. He's still living? Yeah, he teaches piano. Where's Deer? About my side. Do you know his real name?
